description: Minified JavaScript plugin implementing 'Read More'/'Close' toggle functionality for content sections.

classes.name: g
classes.description: Constructor for the Readmore plugin, managing toggle behavior for sections.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin on selected elements, setting up event handlers and styles.

methods.name: toggleSlider
methods.description: Handles toggle between expanded and collapsed states of a section.

methods.name: setBoxHeight
methods.description: Calculates and stores the expanded height of a section.

methods.name: resizeBoxes
methods.description: Adjusts section heights on window resize.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the plugin functionality from elements, cleaning up DOM modifications.
